validation_gates.reason: RFC 3339 permits lowercase 't' and 'z', and the schema's date-time format check (rfc3339-validator is a declared dependency) accepts them, but _dt only replaced an uppercase 'Z', so validate_doc raised ValueError and the CLI printed a traceback for a schema-valid record. A malformed or offset-less KFM_VALIDATION_NOW likewise raised a traceback, or a TypeError when compared with an aware deadline. _dt now normalizes case and requires a UTC offset; a timestamp it cannot compare is returned as a finding naming the field, and both CLIs exit 2 with a one-line message for a misconfigured KFM_VALIDATION_NOW. Four of the new tests error and one fails on the original code.

tests/evidence/test_evidence_temporal_posture_assessment.py: 17 tests (11 before, 6 new), each run through the canonical validator and the legacy wrapper, covering every chronology and posture rule, lowercase separators, instant comparison across offsets, the parse and offset findings when the format check is not enforced, KFM_VALIDATION_NOW handling and the CLI exit codes 0, 1 and 2. Branch coverage rises from 58% to 94% for the validator and from 53% to 94% for the legacy wrapper. The three consuming workflows' test and fixture-replay steps pass as written.

Each of twelve changes failed the suite, among them removing the case normalization, the offset requirement, the early return on parse findings, the ValueError handling, the released_at, SUPERSEDED and WITHDRAWN rules, the deadline comparison direction, the environment lookup, freshness_deadline parsing, and either CLI's exit 2.
ruff reports one fewer finding than before (FURB162: Python 3.11+, the declared minimum, parses 'Z' itself) and no new ones. make repository-guardrails PASS.
